question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/923e4c21d18a1a9c5e2afba9c1d0d09d8a8d0290ad565fdada95bd8e4f344d24.png]
solution: The number of triangles in the given figure is shown below: 1) Number of triangles = [Number of parts × (1 + Number of parts)] ÷ 2 = [2 × (1 + 2)] ÷ 2 = [2 × 3] ÷ 2 = 6 ÷ 2 = 3 As there are 3 same types of triangles, therefore total number of triangles will be (3 × 4) = 12
